title: Job Listings Output Schema
description: Defines the structure of scraped job data pushed to the Apify dataset.

job_id.title: Job ID
job_id.description: Unique numeric identifier extracted from job URL.

job_title.title: Job Title
job_title.description: The title of the job posting.

jobTitle.title: Job Title (CamelCase Alias)
jobTitle.description: The title of the job posting.

company_name.title: Company Name
company_name.description: The name of the hiring organization.

companyName.title: Company Name (CamelCase Alias)
companyName.description: The name of the hiring organization.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location specified on the job posting.

is_remote.title: Is Remote Flag
is_remote.description: True if position specifies remote / work from home.

date.title: Posted Date
date.description: Relative age or date when posted.

postedDate.title: Posted Date (CamelCase Alias)
postedDate.description: Relative age or date when posted.

URL.title: Job URL (Uppercase)
URL.description: Direct URL link to the original job posting.

url.title: Job URL (Lowercase)
url.description: Direct URL link to the original job posting.

jobUrl.title: Job URL (CamelCase Alias)
jobUrl.description: Direct URL link to the original job posting.

description.title: Full Job Description
description.description: Full HTML/text content of the job description.

skills_detected.title: Detected Tech Stack & Skills
skills_detected.description: List of technology skills automatically detected in description.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped At
scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the job was scraped.

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Search query signature that yielded this job.
